flowContents.name: Silver Layer
flowContents.comments: Silver Layer - Cleanses 18 tables and loads into staging schema

processors.name: Log_Silver_Dropped_Records
processors.comments: Logs records that failed validation or insertion

properties.log-message: Record dropped or failed during Silver Staging Load: ${filename}

properties.cleansed: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, customer_no, TRIM(first_name) AS first_name, TRIM(last_name) AS last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, COALESCE(gender, 'Unknown') AS gender, registration_date, COALESCE(status, 'Active') AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT address_id, customer_id, city_id, TRIM(address_line) AS address_line, COALESCE(postal_code, 'N/A') AS postal_code, COALESCE(address_type, 'Primary') AS address_type, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE address_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT city_id, country_id, TRIM(city_name) AS city_name, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE city_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT country_id, TRIM(country_name) AS country_name, UPPER(country_code) AS country_code, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE country_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT subscription_id, customer_id, plan_id, start_date, end_date, COALESCE(status, 'Active') AS status, COALESCE(auto_renew, true) AS auto_renew, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT plan_id, TRIM(plan_name) AS plan_name, COALESCE(monthly_fee, 0.00) AS monthly_fee, video_quality, max_devices, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE plan_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT 
    content_id, 
    content_type_id, 
    title, 
    release_date, 
    duration_minutes, 
    COALESCE("language", 'English') AS "language", 
    COALESCE(age_rating, 'NR') AS age_rating, 
    created_at, 
    updated_at 
FROM FLOWFILE 
WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT content_type_id, TRIM(content_type) AS content_type, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE content_type_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT genre_id, TRIM(genre_name) AS genre_name, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE genre_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT content_id, genre_id, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL AND genre_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT inventory_id, content_id, warehouse_id, barcode, purchase_date, COALESCE(item_condition, 'Good') AS item_condition, COALESCE(status, 'Available') AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE inventory_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT warehouse_id, city_id, TRIM(warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE warehouse_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT rental_id, customer_id, inventory_id, rental_date, due_date, return_date, COALESCE(rental_fee, 0.00) AS rental_fee, COALESCE(late_fee, 0.00) AS late_fee, COALESCE(status, 'Active') AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND inventory_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT stream_id, customer_id, content_id, device_id, start_time, end_time, COALESCE(watch_duration, 0) AS watch_duration, COALESCE(completion_percentage, 0.00) AS completion_percentage, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE stream_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND content_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT payment_id, customer_id, rental_id, subscription_id, payment_method_id, COALESCE(amount, 0.00) AS amount, payment_date, COALESCE(payment_type, 'General') AS payment_type, COALESCE(status, 'Completed') AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE payment_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND amount >= 0

SELECT DISTINCT ticket_id, customer_id, category_id, opened_date, closed_date, COALESCE(priority, 'Medium') AS priority, COALESCE(status, 'Open') AS status, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT review_id, customer_id, content_id, COALESCE(rating, 0) AS rating, TRIM(review_text) AS review_text, review_date, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE review_id IS NOT NULL AND content_id IS NOT NULL AND rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5
SELECT DISTINCT wishlist_id, customer_id, content_id, added_date, created_at, updated_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE wishlist_id IS NOT NULL AND content_id IS NOT NULL
